learning_outcomes.text: Describe the mechanical equivalent models of elastostatics. Furthermore, they know the simplifying assumptions for the models and their application limits.
Assess under which practical conditions the various equivalent models are used.
Describe real problems from mechanical engineering using elastostatics methods and solve the associated mathematical problem.
Interpret the solution of the problem and, in particular, assess whether the respective mechanical model describes the considered problem sufficiently accurately.

syllabus_topics: Linear elastic material behavior and thermoelasticity
Independence in developing complex problem solutions
Design of components and processing of questions within the framework of design theory
teaching_methods: Lectures in seminar form with accompanying exercises
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon passing the written exam. The exam is 120 minutes long and takes place at the end of the semester.
bibliography: Gross, D., Hauger, W.: Technische Mechanik 2
